project_type: Monorepo: Python/FastAPI backend, TypeScript Cloudflare Worker edge, React/Vite frontend, Azure Bicep infra
build_system: pnpm workspaces for JS, pip-compile for Python, Azure Bicep for infra
test_framework: No test files found - project lacks test infrastructure
build_command: N/A - no unified build command; individual apps have their own
verification_instructions: Verify Python syntax with python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(file).read())' for backend files. Verify YAML/JSON with parsing. Verify Bicep syntax visually.
setup_instructions: pip install for backend, pnpm install for JS apps
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages or pull images. Use AST validation for Python files, syntax checks for other files.
contribution_requirements: Commit on feature branch with descriptive messages. One commit per task.
key_patterns: Backend uses FastAPI with lifespan pattern, Upstash Redis (HTTP-based, sync client), httpx for AI clients with retry/streaming patterns, Beanie ODM for MongoDB, pydantic models for request/response
directory_structure: apps/backend/ - FastAPI app with app/ subdirectory; apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker; apps/frontend/ - React/Vite; infra/azure/ - Bicep templates; .github/workflows/ - CI/CD; docs/ - documentation
